workstream: P5 / AC1018 TABLE text-cell border override decoding and bounded DXF transport

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.dxfConstraint: Autodesk TABLE DXF reference defines group 177 as a pre-AutoCAD-2007 cell override mask; group-code type reference assigns 170-179 to 16-bit integers. Writer therefore admits only selected masks <= 65535.

implementation.readerAdmission: AC1018 text cells only; override flags must be a nonempty subset of text-height plus the four ODA border color/lineweight/visibility triplets. It retains only indexed ACI/BYLAYER/BYBLOCK CMC without RGB/name/book/reserved-index side data, lineweight 0..32767, visibility 0/1, exact edge flags implied by selected border fields, and no virtual edges. Unsupported combinations remain readable but semantically incomplete.
implementation.writerAdmission: The same typed field/edge rules plus legacy group-177 value <= 65535; every selected visibility mask must have an explicit typed value. Higher masks, unsupported fields, mismatched edges, and missing companions are refused atomically.

wireProfiles.readerGeneratedVector: 0x3FFE0: text height and all four edges, with color, lineweight and visibility fields for each edge; generated DWG vector is authored from scratch and checks full ODA field order and cursor sentinel.
wireProfiles.writerAsciiBinaryVector: 0x0FFE0: text height and all four edges' color/lineweight fields plus top/right visibility; fits group 177's unsigned 16-bit value domain and checks all emitted group codes and binary typed readback.

failureBehavior: Invalid visibility and virtual-edge combinations remain parsed but incomplete.
Missing a selected visibility value refuses output without replacing the destination or changing caller state; correcting the model allows retry.
True-color/name/book CMC and override masks outside the modeled field set remain refused for strict output.
implementation.fixturePolicy: DWG reader vectors are authored in memory; DXF outputs use temporary paths. No investigation DWG or DXF fixture was added.

focusedTests.coverage: AC1018 all-edge field decoding/order, cursor sentinel, incomplete virtual edges and invalid-visibility behavior; existing AC1021 TABLE cell controls.
AC1018 ASCII/Binary writer fields, all four edge property groups, group-177 0xFFE0 round-trip, explicit selected visibility values, missing-visibility atomic refusal and corrected retry.

physicalSourceRecheck.result: The DWG read completed, but strict export stopped before publication at an unrelated DICTIONARYVAR preflight. No TABLE callback/cell override span was observed. The local hash differs from the earlier paired-DXF source hash; this is not a physical producer or source-to-output witness.

remaining: Find a byte-bound physical AC1018 TABLE producer callback carrying an admitted mask; prove its edge/virtual-edge fields and spans.
Bind that captured cell through typed fields to strict emitted ASCII/Binary DXF bytes and fresh readback.
Qualify native TABLE rendering and shared-edge behavior independently.
